home.heroGreeting: Hello, I'm Nasrin — a Watercolor Artist & Instructor
home.heroParagraph1: Watercolor is more than just a painting technique to me; it is a way of seeing the world with greater sensitivity, calmness, and creativity. Years of creating watercolor artworks and teaching this beautiful medium have shown me that learning to paint depends not only on talent, but also on proper guidance, purposeful practice, and enjoying the creative journey itself.
home.heroParagraph2: I believe that with the right instruction and dedication, anyone can develop their artistic abilities and discover the joy of working with the luminous colors and delicate beauty of watercolor. That is why I have designed my courses in a simple, practical, and step-by-step format, allowing students of all levels to build their skills with confidence.
home.heroParagraph3: My goal is not only to teach techniques, but also to help you nurture your creativity, strengthen your artistic confidence, and experience the satisfaction of creating artworks that reflect your unique vision of the world.
home.bioParagraph: As long as I remember, I loved to be an artist. My journey started 22 years ago in high school and I am still a student of art. Every day I try to experience something new, and I believe that
home.bioQuote: "Art is longing. You never arrive, but you keep going in the hope that you will."
